persName.name: King Zhaoxiang of Qin 秦昭襄王

note.p: King of Qin, reigned 306–251 BC; personal name Ji 稷. Called King Zhao in the Basic Annals of Zhou and King Zhaoxiang in the Basic Annals of Qin.
Qin general; his surname is not recorded in these passages.

persName.name: Duke Wu of Western Zhou 西周武公

note.p: Ruler of the Western Zhou domain, the fief centred on Wangcheng (modern Luoyang) into which the royal house had been divided; Song Zhong (in the Jijie) gives his posthumous title as Duke Wu.

persName.name: Duke Wen of Western Zhou 西周文公

note.p: Son and successor of Duke Wu of Western Zhou, personal name Jiu 咎.

One of the two experts cited in the report on Jinpingshan.
